how_graded.buys: right if the symbol beat SPY from the decision date to the latest close
how_graded.rejections and serious skeptic objection: right if the symbol lagged SPY
how_graded.market stance: risk-on right if SPY rose >0.5% over 5 sessions, risk-off if it fell >0.5%, neutral if it moved less than 2% either way
how_graded.high event risk: right if the symbol moved more than 3% relative to SPY within 5 sessions
